passwords.note: "rrpass1" is the word "pass" with a doubled letter in front and a 1 behind, a small twist on an obvious base.
Freedom is a single dictionary word with no digits or symbols, the kind of pick people make first.
Its sequential "123" and "abc" pieces are popular building blocks, but the "1!" ending makes it less predictable.
Allie is a short first name, and people often pick names like it for passwords.
A colour word with one digit on the end, the standard fix when a site insists on a number.
